changes.old: route exact DTO/behavior detail to spec-engineer with an appropriate draft/blocked handoff and expected output
changes.new: route exact DTO/behavior detail to spec-engineer with a named next owner, expected output, and readiness tied to that owner's ability to produce that output without an unstated architecture choice. In this supplied case A-4 already accepts the architecture and contract owner; exact DTO members are the spec-owner's expected output. A ready handoff to that owner is valid. Any draft/blocked handoff must identify a source-backed missing input or architecture choice preventing that owner's work; do not block it solely because exact DTO members remain to be specified. Implementation must wait for DTO agreement

changes.old: Missing detail blocks only its dependent handoff, not all supported analysis.
changes.new: Missing detail blocks only work that requires it as an input; it does not block the named owner's authorized work to produce that detail or the supported analysis.

only_other_change: Rubric heading labels v2; other closed criteria unchanged.
